Charge.offence: cheating and dishonestly inducing a delivery of property
Charge.punishment: imprisonment for a term which may extend to 10 years, and shall also be liable to fine or to caning or to both
Charge.text: You, Christine Lewis, are charged that you, on or about the 24th day of April 2000, at about 8.10 pm, at the Seiyu Departmental Store at Parkway Parade Shopping Centre, Singapore, did cheat one Wong Fei Hsia, the cashier of Seiyu Departmental Store by deceiving her to believe that the price of a "Pochacco" pencil casing is worth $5.25, when in actual fact, you knew that the price of the said item is worth $16.95, and by such manner of deception, you dishonestly induced the said Wong Fei Hsia to deliver to you the said item for only $5.25 which she would not have done, had she not been so deceived, and you have thereby committed an offence punishable under section 420 of the Penal Code 1871.
